headline: Executive order dealing with the National Space Council, a White House group that advises the President on space policy.
what_it_does: This order deals with the National Space Council, a group inside the White House that helps shape and coordinate US space policy. Only the title was provided, so the specific changes it makes, such as who sits on the council or what it is asked to do, cannot be confirmed here.
